days_meaning: each delivery day costs you this much cash

messages.text: Hello, and thank you for meeting me. I would propose 181 P with delivery on day 10.
I appreciate it, thank you. Could we close at 155 P, delivery on day 10, please?
Last word from me: 150 P, delivery day 0.
Fair enough, thank you. I will meet you partway: 144 P with delivery on day 10.
Thank you, we are getting close. 157 P and delivery on day 0 works for me.
